name: ExLlamaV3 README (EXL3 quantization, based on QTIP)
notes: EXL3 is 'a streamlined variant of QTIP from Cornell RelaxML', described as making SOTA quantization available on consumer hardware. Conversion 'requires only an input model (in HF format) and a target bitrate', 'By computing Hessians on the fly and thanks to a fused Viterbi kernel, the quantizer can convert a model in a single step'. Also documents '2-8 bit cache quantization' as a separate capability. Acknowledges QTIP (arXiv 2406.11235), QuIP# (2402.04396) and Marlin as the intellectual upstream. This is the successor to the archived ExLlamaV2/EXL2 and has no record in this repo. Accessed 2026-10-04.
